# JobSphere Website Analysis

## Business Overview
JobSphere is not just selling job listings; it offers individuals the opportunity to find meaningful work that aligns with their passions and values, empowering them to achieve their dream careers. The ideal customer is a motivated job seeker, likely in the millennial to Gen Z demographic, who values transparency and seeks a user-friendly way to explore career opportunities.
